'''Helik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. After the [[Voidhound]] defeated the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]], Helik participated in the ceremony of honoring the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]].
